attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: South Dakota VMA courses and other board-approved courses in veterinary science and technology (clinical techniques, diagnostics, therapeutics, animal care, record keeping)
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians: proof of at least 12 credit hours in the 24 months before the renewal application. Current renewal form: due July 1, 2026, $5 fee.
rules.rule_quote: …the applicant's continuing education must consist of a minimum of twelve credit hours in the twenty-four months before the submission of the renewal application.
